blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Bella Belen knows talent alone will not be enough for Capital1 to become a contender in the Premier Volleyball League’s 10th anniversary conference. The PVL’s top rookie last season rued the lack of team chemistry after the Solar Spikers squandered a two-set advantage in a 22-25, 18-25, 25-17, 25-20, 15-8 reverse sweep against Choco Mucho in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series opener on Saturday at SM Seaside Cebu Arena. “I think it also comes down to our attitude.
